desc:
Welcome to Pulse! A game for you to explore, roleplay, and create unique customizable characters with customizing features to free your imagination!

Controls:
Movement: WASD / Arrow Keys 
Action: E
Equip/Dequip: Q
Emotes: V [1-9]
(XBox / Mobile Compatible)
